cause_quote: The new branch `else if (claim && eventIsCurrent && thinkingLevel !== undefined)` called `thinkingLevelClaims.delete(claimKey)` even when reconciliation had kept the old row.
user_saw: The Control UI thinking picker briefly switched from Low back to High when an automatic title update arrived before the session list caught up.
summary: The fix requires an admitted session row before thinking metadata from an event can clear a pending choice.
reasoning: I checked that the reducer already returned `applied: true` with the existing active row when it rejected an inactive snapshot at the same clock, and that the Gateway already published title updates carrying thinking metadata. PR #125822 introduced thinking claims and cleared them on that result from the start. The September reconciliation refactor carried the same deletion rule into the file changed by the fix.
